components.heading: Campaign Design
paragraphs: Campaign Design collects editorial graphics where image, type, and information must work at the same speed. The layouts are built to stop the scroll, establish hierarchy, and communicate the essential details without losing atmosphere.
The system uses scale, cropping, texture, and color as practical tools for directing attention. Each composition can stand alone while still feeling compatible with a larger cultural channel.
This initial page is structured to grow into a broader archive as additional campaign assets and context are curated.

components.title: Editorial hierarchy compressed into a mobile format.
components.caption: A portrait-led design with layered typography and a controlled supporting palette.

components.quote: “The design has seconds to establish mood and meaning.”
